items.exampleEn: Our office is in the business district.
items.exampleZh: 我們的辦公室在商業區。

items.exampleEn: The hotel has good sports facilities.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店有很好的運動設施。

items.exampleEn: You need a passport to cross the border.
The new bridge is still under construction.
We need a quiet location for the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一個安靜的地點開會。

items.exampleEn: The market is on the eastern side of the river.
She works in a small art studio.
items.exampleZh: 她在一間小小的藝術工作室工作。

items.exampleEn: He is the best runner in the county.
items.exampleZh: 他是郡裡跑得最快的人。

items.exampleEn: It often snows in the northern mountains.

items.sentenceEn: Parking facilities are available behind the building.

items.audioEn: The road to the airport is closed for construction, so please take the bus.
items.audioZh: 往機場的路因施工封閉，請改搭公車。
items.questionZh: 往機場的路為什麼封閉？
options: Because of heavy snow last night.
Because of a festival in town.

items.sentenceEn: Can you send me the location of the restaurant?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以把餐廳的位置傳給我嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The music studio is on the third floor.

items.stemEn: The school's sports ____ include a pool and two tennis courts.
items.stemZh: 學校的運動設施包括一座游泳池和兩座網球場。

items.stemEn: We can't park here because of the ____ work on the road.
items.stemZh: 因為路上在施工，我們不能停在這裡。

items.passageEn: New apartments for rent in the Oakfield district! Construction finished last month, and the building is in a great location, close to the train station on the eastern side of town. Facilities include a gym, a garden and a small music studio for the people who live there. The district is quiet, and the county library is only a short walk away. If you buy new furniture, the shop next door can deliver it before you move in.
items.passageZh: Oakfield 區新公寓出租！工程上個月完工，大樓地點很好，靠近城東的火車站。設施包括健身房、花園，還有一間給住戶使用的小型音樂工作室。這一區很安靜，走一小段路就到郡立圖書館。如果你買了新家具，隔壁的店可以在你搬進來之前送到。

questions.questionZh: 下列哪一項不是這棟大樓的設施？

items.promptZh: 我的家人住在北部的一個小鎮。
referenceEn: My family lives in a small northern town.
My family lives in a small town in the northern part of the country.
rubricZh: northern 表示「北方的、北部的」，放在名詞前
主詞與動詞一致（例如 my family lives、my family members live 等）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 border 造一個句子，說說邊界附近的情況或經過邊界的經驗。
referenceEn: The small town is near the border, so many people there speak two languages.
We waited an hour at the border during our trip.
rubricZh: 可用 near the border、cross the border、at the border 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的經驗用過去式）
